#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify many feasible large instances."""
import json, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from analyze import parse_request, solve, Invalid
import verify, biggen, hardgen
from runverify import check

def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]); n = int(sys.argv[2])
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    ok=bad=0; worst=0; worstv=0
    for i in range(n):
        nd = rnd.choice([2,5,9,14])
        spec = dict(seed=rnd.randrange(10**6),
                    viol=rnd.choice([0.02,0.05,0.1,0.2,0.3]),
                    wide=rnd.random()<0.8,
                    cap_scale=rnd.choice([1.0,1.5,3.0]),
                    ndoms=nd, max_faults=nd,
                    ncoms=rnd.choice([4,8,12]),
                    nedges=rnd.choice([8,20,32]),
                    nsnap=rnd.choice([1,2,4]),
                    nobs=rnd.choice([32,96,256]),
                    nodes=rnd.choice([5,9,12]))
        big = biggen.build(**spec)
        good, el = check(big); worst=max(worst,el)
        ok+=good; bad+=(not good)
        if rnd.random()<0.4:
            pat = rnd.choice(list(hardgen.PATTERNS))
            kw = {}
            if pat=='cg': kw=dict(ngroups=rnd.choice([2,3,4,7]), wide=rnd.random()<0.5,
                                  nobs_extra=rnd.choice([0,50,200]))
            if pat=='sp': kw=dict(W=rnd.choice([2,3,5,7]), ndoms=rnd.choice([6,14]))
            if pat=='xs': kw=dict(ndoms=rnd.choice([6,14]))
            if pat=='tc': kw=dict(ndoms=rnd.choice([6,14]))
            good, el = check(hardgen.PATTERNS[pat](seed=rnd.randrange(1000), **kw))
            worst=max(worst,el); ok+=good; bad+=(not good)
    print('runverify2 seed=%d: ok=%d bad=%d worst=%.2fs' % (seed, ok, bad, worst))
main()
